versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Payment Integration Guide.
- Provides actionable integration guidance for 8 major payment providers: Stripe, PayPal, Alipay, WeChat Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Razorpay, and Square.
- Includes code examples (TypeScript/Node.js by default), webhook patterns, and comprehensive security best practices.
- Features provider quick reference tables and detailed testing/debugging instructions.
- Focuses responses on practical code, real-world gotchas, and industry-standard security measures.
